mechanisms.name: contracts
mechanisms.hypothesis: Audit the actual callee contract and affected caller family before tuning conversions or argument homes.
mechanisms.clues: Extra argument homes, integer casts of packet addresses, float-word conversions, or values merely live across a call; inspect consumption by callee/callback targets.
mechanisms.success: 150B3C0C reached full-span zero after pointer submission declarations removed an integer-expression spill; its sibling packet was independently checked.
mechanisms.counterexample: 151572D0 and 1514D64C improved after supported contract repairs but remained candidates. Live A1/A2 do not by themselves prove callback parameters.

mechanisms.name: real-state
mechanisms.hypothesis: Separate real loop state and value snapshots from names for recomputable addresses; test one supported storage change.
mechanisms.clues: Extra frame space without matching runtime spill traffic; redundant owner/address locals. Preserve loop-carried cursors, loads across calls, and genuine coordinate snapshots.
mechanisms.success: 1501E540 and 1501E400 matched with direct owner access while preserving real cursor state; 15149FD0/15149D18 removed redundant buffer-address homes.
mechanisms.counterexample: Deleting cursor state first worsened 1501E540 despite fixing its frame; address removal rematerialized work in 1518F7C4. 15107924 requires its coordinate snapshot across a mutating helper.

mechanisms.name: scope-lifetime
mechanisms.hypothesis: Use raw value lifetimes and expression boundaries to explain scheduling; neither shorter nor longer scopes is universally better.
mechanisms.clues: Matching operations but different call-delay scheduling or argument-home order; check whether a nested result scope or redundant value lifetime explains those exact rows.
mechanisms.success: Camera 1512523C and 15125330 matched after lifting result declarations; 1512623C matched after moving an existing assignment into a call argument expression.
mechanisms.counterexample: Camera 15123070 scope restriction worsened 265 to 730. Narrower callback scopes worsened 151572D0; a quad suffix-scope experiment also failed.
